description: The evaluation of the fixture evaluate, sent while the client records spans, so that it carries the context of the client's span of it in traceparent, as W3C's Trace Context writes it in its header of that name. Where R records spans, its span of the evaluation is a child of the client's, so that one trace runs from the client's span through R's. R ignores traceparent where it records none, and replies the same either way.
